chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"A salat (prayer) in my mosque is like one thousand prayers in other than it, except al-Masjid al-Haram, for indeed a salat (prayer) in al-Masjid al-Haram equals one thousand prayers in my mosque."

key_terms.أَلْفَ صَلَاةٍ: one thousand prayers, indicating multiplied reward
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the act of ritual worship being discussed
key_terms.مَسْجِدِي: my mosque, referring to the mosque of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of praying in Masjid al-Nabawi and al-Masjid al-Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith states the immense merit of performing salat (prayer) in the mosque of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and highlights that al-Masjid al-Haram has even greater excellence. It emphasizes the special sanctity of these two sacred mosques and the multiplied reward of worship performed in them.
